instructions: `words` is the CORRECT alignment: i = index, w = word, s / e = start / end in seconds. Never change it.

Fill each decoy's `plants` with 3–6 deliberate mistakes an aligner can only find by listening — fewer on a short clip (even one), since mistakes must stay apart. Mix timing, text and structure mistakes.

move — {"action":"move","word":12,"edge":"start"|"end","shift_ms":-300}: moves one edge of word 12. Positive = later. A neighbour touching that edge moves with it. Use 150–700 ms (150–250 subtle, 250–450 moderate, 450+ obvious). Never push an edge past the far edge of the neighbouring word, before 0 or past the audio end.

overlap — {"action":"overlap","word":12,"edge":"end","shift_ms":250}: same as move, but the neighbour does NOT give way, so the two chips overlap (same-speaker overlap). The edge must end up inside the neighbour.
zero — {"action":"zero","word":12}: the chip collapses to zero length at its start ("edge":"end" collapses it at its end). Only on a word at least 0.15 s long.

replace — {"action":"replace","word":30,"text":"…"}: the chip and the transcript say `text` instead of the word. Use it for a word substitution, homophone, spelling slip, wrong name / entity, missing or wrong accent, wrong number form, a word from the wrong language, a truncated word written in full (or a full word written truncated), or a ((guess)) written without its brackets.
replace_unintelligible — {"action":"replace_unintelligible","word":31,"text":"…"}: only on a word written (()) or ((guess)): invented text where the audio is unintelligible.
delete — {"action":"delete","word":40}: the word is gone from the transcript AND has no chip (a deleted word, or a dropped filler / backchannel).
remove — {"action":"remove","word":40}: the word keeps its text in the transcript but loses its chip (an aligner must add it back).
absorb — {"action":"absorb","word":41,"into":"previous"|"next"}: the word (usually a filler) is deleted and its neighbour's chip stretches over its audio.

join — {"action":"join","word":7,"count":2}: words 7, 8 (… up to count) become one chip — joined words, or spelled letters in one chip. Only where words are separated by spaces (NOT ja_JP or zh_CN), and only when the true boundary is at least 0.2 s away from the middle of the joined chip.

split — {"action":"split","word":9,"parts":["dell'","uscita"]}: one word over several chips. `parts` is optional for a word with an apostrophe (split after it) or a hyphen (split at it); "at" (seconds) sets the split time of two parts.
add — {"action":"add","after_word":20,"text":"the"}: an extra chip in the pause after word 20 (the pause must be at least 0.35 s). Use a word from the same sentence, e.g. a repeat of the word before.
add_noise — {"action":"add_noise","after_word":20,"text":"ah","start":8.1,"end":8.4}: an extra chip over a cough, breath or other noise; start and end in seconds are required.

set_flag — {"action":"set_flag","flag":"multi_speaker"|"overlap_speech"|"synthetic_speech","value":true}: the file is served with that answer set to `value`, the WRONG answer. `value` must be the opposite of the file's own answer in `file_answers` (synthetic_speech on non-English files only). A file whose answer is synthetic_speech true can carry no other mistake; one whose overlap_speech is true can't carry an overlap mistake.
Speakers can't be changed in word alignment, so there is no wrong-speaker mistake.
Keep mistakes at least 3 words apart — mistakes on neighbouring words are refused. Never touch a tag word (text starting with [ or <).
Mark the 1–2 most obvious mistakes "critical": true (must-catch). Optional "note" is for you only.

Instead of `plants`, a decoy may give `decoy_words`: the whole wrong alignment, [{"w":"…","s":1.2,"e":1.5}, …] in spoken order. Every difference from `words` becomes a mistake. A word with no s / e is in the transcript with no chip; a word left out is gone from both; a retyped word changes the transcript too; extra, split and joined chips leave the transcript as it was. Copy tag words exactly. "critical": true on an entry makes the mistake on its word must-catch. `plants` may then hold only set_flag edits.
Return the SAME JSON with only `plants` (or `decoy_words`) filled. Do not add, remove or edit any other field.
